title: A clinical trial of MK-7262 and enlicitide in participants with high lipoprotein(a) (MK-7262-004)
official: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of MK-7262 as Monotherapy and when Coadministered with Enlicitide Decanoate in Adults With Elevated Lipoprotein(a)
summary:
Main objective: 1.	To demonstrate the superiority of MK-7262 Dose 1 coadministered with enlicitide compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a) and LDL-C, superiority of MK-7262 Dose 1 monotherapy compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a), and to demonstrate the relative contribution of MK-7262 Dose 1 and enlicitide compared with the monotherapies to each of Lp(a) and LDL-C at Week 8.
2.	To demonstrate the superiority of MK-7262 Dose 2 coadministered with enlicitide compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a) and LDL-C, superiority of MK-7262 Dose 2  monotherapy compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a), and to demonstrate the relative contribution of MK-7262 Dose 2 and enlicitide compared with the monotherapies to each of Lp(a) or LDL-C at Week 8. 
3.	To demonstrate the superiority of MK-7262 Dose 3 coadministered with enlicitide compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a) and LDL-C, superiority of MK-7262 Dose 3 monotherapy compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a), and to demonstrate the relative contribution of MK-7262 Dose 3 and enlicitide compared with the monotherapies to each of Lp(a) or LDL-C at Week 8. 
4.	To demonstrate the superiority of MK-7262 Dose 4 coadministered with enlicitide compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a) and LDL-C, superiority of MK-7262 Dose 4 monotherapy compared with placebo on reduction in Lp(a), and to demonstrate the relative contribution of MK-7262 Dose 4 and enlicitide compared with the monotherapies to each of Lp(a) or LDL-C at Week 8.
5.	To evaluate the safety and tolerability of coadministered MK-7262 (Dose 1, Dose 2, Dose 3, Dose 4) + enlicitide, MK-7262 (Dose 1, Dose 2, Dose 3, Dose 4) monotherapy, and enlicitide monotherapy.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has Lp(a) ≥ 150 nmol/L
2. Is receiving an optimized and stable dose of statin for ≥ 30 days with no planned additions, dose changes, or discontinuations through the duration of the study
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has a history of homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (FH), compound heterozygous FH, or double heterozygous FH
2. Has a history of class IV heart failure, severe ventricular systolic dysfunction, uncontrolled ventricular arrhythmia, markedly prolonged corrected QT interval, untreated hypertension, or a recent coronary, cerebrovascular, or peripheral ischemic event or arterial revascularization
3. Has human immunodeficiency virus infection, unless the infection is controlled (i.e. undetectable viral load)
4. Has an active hepatitis C virus infection or active or chronic hepatitis B virus infection
5. Has a history of nephrotic syndrome
6. Has severe renal insufficiency
7. Has received certain therapies in the prohibited timeframe as specified in the protocol
8. Has active or chronic hepatobiliary or hepatic disease
9. Has poorly controlled Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes
